# Vendored frontend assets

These files are committed so Forge's UI loads without any network access. They
are pinned to the versions below and refreshed with `scripts/vendor.sh` (or
`make vendor`). Do not edit them by hand.

| Directory | Package | Version | License | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bootstrap/` | Bootstrap | 5.3.3 | MIT | https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap |
| `bootstrap-icons/` | Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | MIT | https://github.com/twbs/icons |
| `marked/` | marked | 12.0.2 | MIT | https://github.com/markedjs/marked |
| `highlight/` | highlight.js | 11.10.0 | BSD-3-Clause | https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js |
